module: "timeLimit" scenario goal: the scenario must be completed in less than maxTime seconds. Loaded by scenario_raceGoals (init, processState, updateFinalStatus); declared in goals.vehicles with id 'timeLimit'. Can display a countdown over the last seconds and fails if the time is exceeded.
notes: instance.value fields: maxTime (s), waitTime (s of tolerance after maxTime during the race), countdown (s: threshold for displaying the countdown), msg (failure message).

During 'onRaceTick' (only if waitTime is defined and maxTime ~= 0): if countdown is provided, displays a message every second below the threshold; if scenario.timer > maxTime + waitTime, failure (failedGoal -> scenario_scenarios.finish({failed=...})). On 'onRaceResult': failure if scenario.finalStatus.finalTime > maxTime, otherwise the status becomes 'passed'.
BUG/inconsistency: init rejects the instance only if maxTime AND waitTime are NOT numbers (and operator); a single invalid value passes.

BUG/inconsistency: without waitTime, the 'onRaceTick' check is skipped (only 'onRaceResult' checks the limit). instance.wait is initialized to countdown (may be nil, which would make the comparison timeleft < instance.wait fail if countdown is nil but defined otherwise).
BUG/inconsistency: updateFinalStatus ignores its instance argument and redeclares the loop variable of the same name.
The default failure message is {txt = 'extensions.scenario.timeLimit.failedGoal', context = {maxTime}}; value not translated in this file.

instances.desc: 'timeLimit' goal instances for the current scenario, filled by init.

init.desc: Rebuilds M.instances from scenario.goals.vehicles (id == 'timeLimit') after validating the types of maxTime/waitTime/countdown; instance.wait receives countdown.

processState.desc: Called by scenario_raceGoals on every event: handles 'onRaceTick' (countdown and exceeding maxTime + waitTime) and 'onRaceResult' (comparison of the final time to maxTime).

updateFinalStatus.desc: Called at the end of the scenario: publishes the status of each instance to statistics_statistics.
